rows.evidence: src/diagnostics.jl:729; src/assembly.jl:619 (no declaration_error anywhere in src/)
rows.fix: Say the sketch's `declaration_error` stands for `throw(DiagnosticError(UnknownFaceSelection(...)))` with reason `:multiple_selectors` or `:unknown_names`, or rename the stand-in in the sketch.

rows.claim: the :multiple_selectors diagnostic reads "more than one selector given"
rows.fix: Drop the quotation marks, or quote the message as written: "were given together — the three selectors are exclusive, one per call".
rows.note: The phrase appears only in the diagnostic type's docstring (diagnostics.jl:728). The message text differs (probe:230).

rows.claim: an `only` may name faces that exist while keeping nothing, and so raise EmptyFaceSelection
rows.fix: Write: "A `select` may match none, or an `except` may list every face." A non-empty `only` of known names keeps them all, and an empty `only` counts as not given.
rows.note: src/assembly.jl:633-641 says `only` cannot reach the warning; src/diagnostics.jl:749 records `:only` as never constructed. probe:265 shows only = () is not a selector.
